title: She had five husbands.
paragraphs:
She had five husbands.
They had spotless reputations.
The other group was avoided by Jesus.
At a well in the heat of the day, the woman everyone rejected met the One who saw her, knew her, and still spoke with her.

Religion kept its distance.
Jesus started a conversation.
The question isn’t just about her.

Would our churches recognize her hunger…
or only her history?
Do churches today feel safer for the “put together”… or the “broken”?
